bindings.label: A female teenage high school student presented with fatigue, recurrent sinus infections, migraines, and anemia
She had one prior episode of immune thrombocytopenic purpura requiring intravenous immunoglobulin treatment, with negative autoimmune workup results

She experienced episodic abdominal pain since childhood initially diagnosed as irritable bowel syndrome, and recent colonoscopy demonstrated collagenous colitis; no family history of autoimmune disorders or chronic infections was reported
Physical examination showed mild eczema and patchy hair loss
During a subsequent hospital admission, she developed severe headache, gastrointestinal distress, fatigue, arthralgias, and skin eruption on bilateral extremities
Laboratory tests show low IgG4 and IgM levels
Lymphocyte subset analysis shows T and B lymphopenia
Coombs test is positive for autoimmune hemolytic anemia
Inflammatory markers ESR and CRP are elevated
Genetic testing was performed but specific variants and vaccine titers are missing
Common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) with immune dysregulation
Monogenic immune dysregulation syndrome (e.g., CTLA4/LRBA deficiency)
T and B lymphocyte functional testing results are not yet available
